Marco: Quick kickoff — Dual-phase joint benchmark with AltChip next week. Goals: perf/W baseline + sustained throughput 99th percentile. Need kernel‑tuning window and telemetry schema. @Zach @Olivia can you confirm hardware availability and any lab constraints? :wave:
Zach (AltChip): We can supply 4 cards in lab-7, provisioning Thu–Fri. Drivers currently 2.8.1, firmware 1.4 pending. Lab network VLAN is reserved. Any required kernel version?
Anya (Perf Eng): Plan sketch: Phase A (perf/W sweep) — 128-token LLM runs, power sampling every 10s, CPU+GPU stack steady-state windows. Phase B (throughput) — 8 concurrent streams for 2h to probe scheduler/backpressure. We'll provide runner and workloads. Need root access to hw telemetry port and ability to toggle powercap/governor and SMT.
Olivia (Solutions): I'll coordinate partner side and send calendar invites. Marketing wants an embargo on numbers until cross-validation. Any export/control or NDA flags from partner?
Marco: NDA is already in place for this partner. Marketing embargo is fine — target lift after QA sign-off. Telemetry schema: use Redwood perf-schema v2 (S3: s3://redwood-bench/telemetry/schema/v2.json). Please align field names and units.
bench-bot: bench-bot: booked lab-7 for 2024-06-12 09:00 — 2024-06-13 18:00 (reserved by zach). :white_check_mark:
Sid (Eng): For kernel tuning we need perf counters: L1-dcache-load-misses, LLC-loads, GPU_SM_UTIL, mem_bandwidth. Adding tracing hook to runner — example config:
```yaml
workload: llm-128
streams: 8
perf_counters:
  - L1-dcache-load-misses
  - LLC-loads
  - GPU_SM_UTIL
power_sample_interval_s: 10
```
Zach (AltChip): Driver 2.8.1 confirmed, firmware 1.4 patch ETA tomorrow. We're running kernel 6.1.19 on lab nodes — OK to lock to 6.1.x?
Anya (Perf Eng): 6.1.x is fine. We'll pin test harness to commit abc1234 and run a quick smoke (1k tokens) once firmware is applied to validate power sensors and telemetry.
Olivia (Solutions): Marketing checklist: draft joint blog + co-branded slide deck. Please flag any embargo issues. Proposed embargo lift target: 2024-06-20.
Marco: Next steps — Olivia send invites + agenda; Zach confirm firmware + node access; Anya upload workloads to s3://redwood-bench/incoming/altchip-dualphase; Sid add perf counter set and runner hooks. Ping me once smoke passes. :thumbsup:
bench-bot: bench-bot: smoke run scheduled 2024-06-11 03:00 UTC. Will post run logs here (upload to s3://redwood-bench/runs/6378901234/).
